verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי־ יָג֣וּר בְּאָהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי־ יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh mî- yā·ḡūr bə·’ā·ho·le·ḵā mî- yiš·kōn bə·har qāḏ·še·ḵā
verses.literal: A Psalm of David O LORD who may abide in Your tent Who may dwell on Your holy mountain

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ tā·mîm ū·p̄ō·‘êl ṣe·ḏeq wə·ḏō·ḇêr ’ĕ·meṯ bil·ḇā·ḇōw
verses.literal: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness who speaks the truth from his heart

verses.original: לֹֽא־ רָגַ֨ל׀ עַל־ לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא־ עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא־ נָשָׂ֥א עַל־ קְרֹֽבוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- rā·ḡal ‘al- lə·šō·nōw lō- ‘ā·śāh lə·rê·‘ê·hū rā·‘āh wə·ḥer·pāh lō- nā·śā ‘al- qə·rō·ḇōw
verses.literal: who has no slander on his tongue who does no harm to his neighbor who casts no scorn . . . . . . on his friend

verses.original: נִבְזֶ֤ה׀ בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת־ יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·zeh bə·‘ê·nāw nim·’ās wə·’eṯ- yir·’ê Yah·weh yə·ḵab·bêḏ niš·ba‘ lə·hā·ra‘ wə·lō yā·mir
verses.literal: who despises . . . the vile but honors those who fear the LORD who does not revise a costly oath

verses.original: כַּסְפּ֤וֹ׀ לֹא־ נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל־ נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה־ אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kas·pōw lō- nā·ṯan bə·ne·šeḵ wə·šō·ḥaḏ ‘al- nā·qî lō lā·qāḥ ‘ō·śêh- ’êl·leh lō yim·mō·wṭ lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent He who does these things will never . . . be shaken
